messages:
Anya K: Quick sync — starting bring-up for open-infer-13b-q4 (quantized). Need an intake checklist focused on chat templates + API integration (tool-calls, structured output, headers). Can folks add must-checks + known reg flags? @Sam R @Miguel M
Sam R: Got it. I'll add perf targets and latency budgets. Note: KV cache behavior changes with q4; test long-context throughput and cache hits.
Miguel M: I'll own prompt formatting and function-call verification. Reminder: existing chat schema accepts either `content` or `tool_call` objects. We need a fallback mapping to plain assistant text when function call fails.
Lee T: Flag from prior runs — embeddings drifted after quantization. Add an embed-sanity step: compute cosine w.r.t baseline on the eval set, and threshold at 0.92.
Olivia Q: Suggested checklist items:
- Prompt template parity tests (system, user, assistant sequences)
- Function-call roundtrip + schema validation
- Structured-output JSON schema validation (ajv)
- Regression tests: QA prompt set + hallucination fuzzing
- Sampling stability (same seed across runs)
Sam R: API example for function calling — we'll run this in integration tests:
```json
{
  "model": "open-infer-13b-q4",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a product assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Lookup price for widget 42"}
  ],
  "functions": [{"name": "price_lookup", "parameters": {"type": "object"}}],
  "max_tokens": 256
}
```
eval-bot: baseline-compare job queued -> job_id: eval-2026-11-07-axy123 (will post results here)
Anya K: Add structured-output check: validate response against schema with ajv, fail build on validation errors. Example schema snippet: `{"type":"object","properties":{"price":{"type":"number"}},"required":["price"]}`
Miguel M: Also: ensure routing header `x-redwood-variant: dequant` is set when falling back to non-quant model. This avoids silent mismatches.
Lee T: I'll run end-to-end tests on staging tomorrow 10:00 PT and report perf + regressions.
Anya K: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into the onboarding checklist doc and ping @eng-platform for autoscaling/routing policy notes. :thumbsup:
